$comment: Repo-owned layer on top of data/style-library.json. That file is an export of the private distillation pipeline and gets rewritten by its sync script, so everything hand-written lives here: `overrides` patches an upstream template by id (language-keyed fields such as title.ja and copyPrompt are merged per language), `templates` holds complete templates that only exist in this repo, `categories` adds or patches categories. copyPrompt is the one-line lead-in with 【】 / [ ] placeholders that opens the copy-ready block in docs/templates/{zh,en}/<id>.md. Merged by scripts/lib/library.mjs.
